name: Question 4
problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,(B∧A)∨B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
worked_solution:
First, we complete a truth table for the part in parentheses, $B∧A.$ The statement $B∧A$ is true if both $A$ and $B$ are true.

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∧A\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Then, we look at the columns labeled $B∧A$ and the column $B$ to complete the column $(B∧A)∨B.$ The statement $(B∧A)∨B$ is true if either $B∧A$ is true, $B$ is true, or both $B∧A$ and $B$ are true.

The completed truth table is shown below:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∧A\,$ | $\,(B∧A)∨B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
